status_legend.SOURCE_IMPLEMENTED: Equivalent core workflow exists in VeraMesh source.
status_legend.SOURCE_PARTIAL: Useful equivalent exists but RDC convenience/shape is not fully copied.
status_legend.DELIBERATELY_OMITTED: Omitted to avoid unnecessary authority or product-specific behavior.
status_legend.NOT_REPLACEMENT_REQUIREMENT: RDC product/account helper, not needed for workstation control.

rows.notes: Current cut targets Lappy; no general multi-device directory UI yet.
RDC account/usage metadata is product-specific.
VeraMesh treats authenticated app response as health, not transport reachability alone.
Remote self-shutdown is not required for control parity.

rows.veramesh: source-controlled/local protected service and controller configs
rows.notes: Remote config mutation is intentionally not a normal workstation tool.

rows.veramesh: local protected config change + service restart
rows.notes: Avoids remotely widening allowed roots/process authority.
Special PDF/DOCX/XLSX decoding is not part of the remote-control primitive.
No dedicated batching primitive yet.
Write is capability/claim/fence gated.
Artifact rendering is separate from workstation transport/control.
Paginated deterministic one-directory listing; recursion can be composed.
Bounded synchronous search instead of server-side search sessions.
Search is bounded per request and creates no background search worker.
No background search sessions exist.
Atomic write; mismatch is no-effect.
argv only; no implicit shell.
Input has separate process.interact capability and a 65536-byte per-call bound.
Only lane/fence-owned managed processes.
Only managed processes owned by the lane/fence.
Host-wide process inventory would widen authority beyond managed children.
Arbitrary host PID kill is intentionally not granted by initial process.control.
No RDC-style product telemetry.
Ledger preserves mutation safety, not a user-facing full read/write history.

extension_research.windows_ui_automation: Other Windows MCP projects demonstrate screenshots/accessibility-tree/UI control. VeraMesh may add these later behind distinct capabilities; they are not required for the first RDC filesystem/terminal replacement.
extension_research.broad_host_control: Other MCPs often inherit the full authority of their OS account. VeraMesh deliberately keeps local roots, capability ceilings, lane claims, fences, and process ownership.
